caseNameFull: Frank C. Stettler, in Error v. Edwin V. O'Hara, Constituting the Industrial Welfare Commission of the State of Oregon and Elmira Simpson, in Error v. Edwin V. O'Hara, Constituting the Industrial Welfare Commission of the State of Oregon
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Oregon.
attorneys: Mr. Charles W. Fulton and Mr. Rome G. Brown for plaintiffs in error., Mr. Felix Frankfurter, Mr. A. M. Crawford, Mr. J. N. Teal and Mr. Geo. M. Brown for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgments affirmed with costs by an equally divided court. (Mr. Justice Brandéis took no part in the consideration and decision of these cases.)

Mr. Felix Frankfurter, Mr. A. M. Crawford, Mr. J. N. Teal and Mr. Geo. M. Brown for defendants in error.
